demos.name: Meridian Air LAB
demos.description: The Airline That Runs on Agents: 11 chat-first scenes (MA1-MA11) — MCP booking, LLM routing with virtual keys, cost control, A2A from AgentCore, agent badges, CIBA+PingID refund, AI Guard vs prompt injection, fine-grained authorization, governance, credential broker, Elasticsearch audit evidence. Mock runs offline.
demos.notes: Mock only by default (no SaaS Ping products shared; Real mode uses SaaS PingOne and is owner-run). Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7832). Docker: HOST_PORT=7832 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Settings: the app's own .env beside docker-compose.yml (copy .env.example; MA_* names). Fork of customer-agent-LAB with the catalog replaced by the 11 airline scenes. Live was owner-verified 2026-11-05 on the fork's parent; Real was owner-verified 2026-11-22 in this lab: MA1 books a real flight (PERMIT, confirmation number) through PingOne pi.flow sign-in, two RFC 8693 exchanges, the P1AZ policy and the SE Agent Gateway; MA2/3/7/8/11 run Real the same way. The shelf checkout beside this entry must carry this repo's .env (Real settings) or a shelf-started lab is Mock-only.
